title: Capitalization Bylaws, Schedule of Classes — Member Equities & Patronage: Who Holds Each Class, Voting and Issue
content:
Member Equities & Patronage at Cottonwood Plains Farm Credit, ACA are issued in six classes. Every borrower is a member-owner through one borrower equity class; patronage comes back partly as allocated surplus; and members may invest in preferred stock. This schedule sets out, class by class, who the class is issued to, what causes it to be issued, its par or stated value, its vote, and how it ranks.

## Holder and manner of acquisition

| Class | Holder | Acquired by |
|---|---|---|
| Class C Participation Certificate | A borrower who is not a farmer or rancher in their own right (rural homeowners, rural residents) | Loan closing |
| Class A Nonvoting Common Stock | A borrower that processes or markets farm products or furnishes farm services (agribusiness members) | Loan closing |
| Class B Voting Stock | A bona fide farmer, rancher or producer or harvester of aquatic products borrowing for agricultural purposes | Loan closing |
| Qualified Allocated Surplus | Any member with patronage-eligible loan volume, the member's consent being given under the bylaws | Patronage allocation |
| Nonqualified Allocated Surplus | Any member with patronage-eligible loan volume | Patronage allocation |
| Class H Preferred Stock | Any member in good standing, with a purchase of at least USD 1000 and the offering circular acknowledged | Member purchase |

## Schedule of class terms

| | Class C Participation Certificate | Class A Nonvoting Common Stock | Class B Voting Stock | Qualified Allocated Surplus | Nonqualified Allocated Surplus | Class H Preferred Stock |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Par or stated value of one share, certificate or allocation unit (USD) | 5 | 5 | 5 | 1 | 1 | 1 |
| Carries a vote in director elections and bylaw changes | No | No | Yes | No | No | No |
| Votes a member holding the class has, regardless of amount held | 0 | 0 | 1 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Member segments to which the class is issued as borrower equity | Rural homeowner | Agribusiness | Farm operator | Farm operator, agribusiness, rural homeowner | Farm operator, agribusiness, rural homeowner | Farm operator, agribusiness, rural homeowner |
| What causes the class to be issued | Loan closing | Loan closing | Loan closing | Patronage allocation | Patronage allocation | Member purchase |
| A member holds at most one holding of the class (all amounts pooled in it) | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| May be transferred to another member with the association's consent | No | No | No | No | No | Yes |
| Member must acknowledge that the equity is at risk and not insured before issue | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Order of repayment in a liquidation (1 first) | 2 | 2 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 1 |
| How often the member receives an equity statement | Annual | Annual | Annual | Annual | Annual | Quarterly |

The member segment is the member's primary segment on the association's record. Preferred and allocated classes are open to any segment.

## Holding statuses

A holding of any class moves through these statuses:

- **Subscribed** to **active** — the equity was issued: stock or a participation certificate at the closing of the member's loan, allocated surplus at the first patronage allocation, preferred stock when the purchase funds cleared.
- **Subscribed** to **cancelled** — the loan the subscription was made for was declined or withdrawn before closing and the subscription was cancelled.
- **Active** to **retirement requested** — the member, or the estate's representative, asked in writing for the equity to be retired or redeemed.
- **Retirement requested** to **retired** — the board-approved retirement was paid and the holding's balance is zero.
- **Retirement requested** to **active** — the retirement was deferred or declined and the holding remains outstanding.
- **Active** to **retired** — the association retired the holding's last balance on its own motion (revolvement of the last allocation year, or offset against a loan in default).

The holding's balance is the par or stated value of the equity held — raised by purchases, retained patronage and reinvested dividends, and lowered by retirements, revolvements, redemptions and offsets. Cash patronage declared to the member and not yet paid is carried as patronage payable — raised by cash declarations and by voided payouts, lowered by payouts.

## Reading the schedule

- **Which classes vote?** Only Class B Voting Stock, with one vote per member however much is held.
- **Which class is repaid first in a liquidation?** Class H Preferred Stock (rank 1), then the three borrower equity classes (rank 2), then Qualified Allocated Surplus (rank 3), then Nonqualified Allocated Surplus (rank 4).
- **Hypothetical illustration.** A rural homeowner who borrows is issued a Class C Participation Certificate at loan closing; a crop farmer borrowing for agricultural purposes is issued Class B Voting Stock; either may also hold allocated surplus from patronage and buy Class H Preferred Stock.
